core_obligations: Get universal injectivity of the map into the completion and the Mittag-Leffler property of the completion (proof lines 2163-2169).
Deduce that the module itself is Mittag-Leffler as a pure submodule of a Mittag-Leffler module (proof lines 2170-2172).
Conclude projectivity from countable generation, flatness and the Mittag-Leffler property (proof lines 2173-2175).
proof_roadmap: Universal injectivity and Mittag-Leffler for the completion (proof lines 2163-2169).
Projectivity by the countably generated criterion (proof lines 2173-2175).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a freeness criterion over a complete Noetherian ring: under a condition on the associated primes of the fibres, a flat finite module whose reduction modulo the ideal is projective is projective over the base (statement lines 2144-2161, tag 05FY-adjacent). The proof uses universal injectivity of the map into the completion and the Mittag-Leffler property of the completion to conclude that the module is Mittag-Leffler as a pure submodule, and then applies the criterion for a countably generated flat Mittag-Leffler module to be projective. The purity argument is the substance, so the claim is H2.
